notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention (bank 't' = rows a-e, 'b' = rows f-j). In the image the rows a-e are the lower half, so the pot's two outer legs are in the lower half (columns 10 and 12, row e) and its middle leg is in the upper half (column 11, row f).
The yellow wire end is drawn touching the pot's middle leg at column 11 upper half; modelled as plugged into 11b.g, the same strip as the pot's SIG leg at 11b.f.
The black wire goes to the second GND header pin next to 5V on the Uno power header (modelled as GND.2).
Pot outer pins: GND at column 10 (black wire), VCC at column 12 (red wire to 5V). The pot is symmetric between GND and VCC, so this assignment is interchangeable.
No external LED circuit is listed. The Arduino is assumed to be powered over USB, which the manual does not show.
